hypotheses.A0_sitewise_compact_route_exists: The hindsight-best size-3 mask reaches median full-reference fidelity at least 0.98 and 10th-percentile fidelity at least 0.90 on both corpora.
hypotheses.A1_query_route_repeats: A size-3 mask frozen per tensor query on its first FineWeb site reaches median fidelity at least 0.95 and 10th-percentile fidelity at least 0.80 on the second FineWeb sites and WikiText.
hypotheses.A2_local_route_atlas: Sitewise compact routes pass A0 but query-frozen routes fail A1, indicating that the useful suffix chart changes within a tensor query.
hypotheses.A3_some_sites_need_broad_suffix: Even the hindsight-best size-3 mask has 10th-percentile full-reference fidelity below 0.80 on either corpus.
hypotheses.A4_weight_objective_finds_route: Selecting the size-3 mask by exact tangent objective is within 0.05 median fidelity of the hindsight finite selector on both corpora.
